display_information.name: Relay
display_information.description: Routes client requests into engineering and tracks them as tasks.
display_information.long_description: Relay watches your client channels. When a client asks for something — a bug, a feature, a PR review — it posts the request into your engineering channel where a teammate claims it with a reaction. From that thread the team ships status updates and follow-up questions straight back into the client's own thread, so nobody has to copy messages between channels by hand.
